name: 雅思高频补充词·第一批
items: His excuse sounded plausible at first.
他的借口乍一听还挺可信。
The proposal came under intense scrutiny.
该提案受到了严格审查。
Supply chains need to become more resilient.
The final design was a sensible compromise.
最终的设计是合理的折中方案。
Safety sits high in the hierarchy of needs.
安全在需求层次中排位很高。
Early investment can mitigate later losses.
早期投入可以减轻后续损失。
A pragmatic solution beats a perfect one that never ships.
务实的方案胜过永远落不了地的完美方案。
Every claim in the report was scrutinised.
报告中的每一项主张都被仔细核查过。
There is a trade-off between speed and accuracy.
速度与准确性之间存在权衡。
The market has been turbulent this quarter.
信任支撑着每一段持久的合作关系。
